verdict.rationale: The pack contains a speed claim ("high-performance LLMs") but nothing that backs it: no tokens-per-second or latency figures, no benchmarks, and no load-testing guide. The Performance Client (concurrent requests from Python, JavaScript, or Rust) and a community note about a client-side GIL bottleneck are about client throughput tooling. Neither publishes speed numbers or describes a load-testing method, so they don't meet the story.
